description: Low pass gate on the Buchla model published by Parker and D'Angelo, with extra controls for shaping the gate signal before it reaches the vactrol

params.text: Adds a positive or negative offset to the gate signal, which sets its minimum and maximum
Sets the resonance of the filter in LOWPASS mode
Attenuates and inverts the OFFSET input before it is added to the OFFSET knob
Attenuates and inverts the RESONANCE input before it is added to the RESONANCE knob
Sets how much of the vactrol behaviour reaches the gate: counter-clockwise the gate follows the gate signal quickly, clockwise it behaves more like an envelope
Attenuates and inverts the SHARPNESS input before it is added to the SHARPNESS knob
Attenuates or amplifies the gate signal, so the gate can be opened or closed further
Attenuates and inverts the RANGE input before it is added to the RANGE knob
Picks what the gate controls: VCA for the amplitude of the signal, LOWPASS for the cutoff frequency of the filter

inputs.text: The signal that opens and closes the gate, where a low voltage opens it only part of the way
The audio input to the gate
A control voltage added to the OFFSET setting, scaled by the OFFSET attenuverter
A control voltage added to the RESONANCE setting, scaled by the RESONANCE attenuverter
A control voltage added to the SHARPNESS setting, scaled by the SHARPNESS attenuverter
A control voltage added to the RANGE setting, scaled by the RANGE attenuverter
